system.description:
The Lord Protector can summon forth his raw Grief and hone it into a fine rage. While he sings of his wrathful sorrow and coming vengeance, Grief dice are added to the Lord Protector’s weapon skills.

Obstacle: See Description. Grief FoRKs to weapon skill, Ob 1. Grief helps weapon skill, Ob 2. Half of Grief added to weapon skill, Ob 3. All of Grief added, Ob 5.

Actions: 4x obstacle

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Song Root: Grief. The system cannot use Grief as a root; Will is set instead.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 145
